description: This file defines an Android NFC HostApduService implementation (CardService) that handles APDU commands for card emulation, specifically responding to select commands with account data and status words. It demonstrates how to interface with NFC card emulation features introduced in Android 4.4.

classes.name: CardService
classes.description: Android NFC HostApduService implementation handling APDU commands for card emulation, responding with account information or status words.

methods.name: onDeactivated
methods.description: Called when NFC connection is lost or the card is deselected.

methods.name: processCommandApdu
methods.description: Processes incoming APDU commands, checking for SELECT AID, returning account data or unknown response.

methods.name: BuildSelectApdu
methods.description: Constructs the SELECT AID command APDU for a given AID.

methods.name: ByteArrayToHexString
methods.description: Converts byte array to hexadecimal string for logging.

methods.name: HexStringToByteArray
methods.description: Converts hexadecimal string to byte array for APDU commands.

methods.name: ConcatArrays
methods.description: Concatenates multiple byte arrays into one array.
